answer: Each agent identity locks a bond that decays like a lotus losing a petal per epoch. A newcomer posts 100 credits; the bond shrinks 5 per epoch unless the agent keeps working honestly, so idle fakes bleed value while a real agent tops it up. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 credits; one honest agent pays 100 and earns it back in fees. A yarrow seller and juniper grower trading keep bonds whole; fresh shells with no history cannot fake that.
